hypotheses.justification: Nothing uses this instance. The statement does not need it. `Ctx M Q Z B`, `Sec7Hyp hc n t`, `OmegaPlusNat hc t 3`, `IsCentrePre Z0 (Rt M (LB M Q B) t) Q` and `Sec717L hc t Z0 L` are all defined without any `Normal` instance. `Ctx` is a structure over `StrothHyp M Q Z`. The normality of Q in M that the proof needs comes from the field `hc.hyp.Q_normal.2` (M ≤ normalizer Q), not from the instance. The hypotheses `hA`, `hPts`, `hCN`, `hCM`, `hZc` and `h51` are universally quantified statements over `[Group G] [Finite G]` and `Ctx`. None of them takes a `Normal` instance, so none is applied to it. The lemmas the proof calls have no such argument either: `sec7ctr_Z0_le_CN`, `sec7ctr_Z0_data`, `sec717CardDvd_of_omegaPlus`, `Ctx.sq_mem_Q_of_mem_LB`, `Ctx.LB_conj`, `IsCentrePre.mem_normalizer`, `sec717_sq_mem_of_sup`, `sec717SqQ` and `sec717_conj_eq_of_inv`. The only `Normal` instance the proof uses is `hQZn : (Q.subgroupOf Z0).Normal`, which it builds itself. It never uses `Q.subgroupOf M` as a quotient. So deleting the binder leaves the statement and proof unchanged and still valid, and no degenerate case arises.
